project_type: Vanilla JavaScript portfolio website with Three.js 3D elements
build_system: Static HTML site - no build step required. Direct file serving via Apache/Laragon
test_framework: Manual browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari). OWASP ZAP for security scanning
test_command: Open index.html in browser, verify all sections load, test form submission at http://localhost/Portofolio_Ilham/
verification_instructions: 1. Open in browser via localhost server (required for form API). 2. Test all sections scroll smoothly. 3. Verify 3D canvas renders. 4. Test contact form submission. 5. Check responsive breakpoints (900px, 768px). 6. Verify dark/light theme toggle. 7. Test custom cursor on desktop. 8. Run OWASP ZAP scan for security vulnerabilities.
environment_constraints: Must run through web server (Laragon/localhost) not file:/// protocol for form submission to work. Three.js r128 loaded from CDN. Google Fonts external dependency. FormSubmit.co API for contact form.
contribution_requirements: User requires: 1. Keep ALL existing content/assets unchanged. 2. Maintain 3D avatar canvas feature. 3. Achieve minimalist-clean but NOT rigid design. 4. Add unique shapes and eye-catching animations. 5. Rich, cinematic motion graphics with high wow-factor. 6. Responsive across all screen sizes. 7. Fix all OWASP ZAP security warnings.
key_patterns: CSS: Minified components.css, modular structure (variables.css, components.css, layout.css imported into style.css). Custom properties for theming. JS: IIFE modules, IntersectionObserver for reveals, custom cursor with RAF animation loop. HTML: Semantic structure, ARIA labels throughout, reveal classes for scroll animations.
directory_structure: Root: index.html, .htaccess. css/: modular CSS files. js/: feature-specific JS modules. assets/: images/ (profil images, project screenshots, certificates), CV PDFs. No node_modules, no build artifacts.
